purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined urban supermarket with legible customer, sales-floor, checkout, receiving, storage, cold-chain, and staff functions.
architectural_rules: Customer entry and exit must resolve through a recognizable front-end checkout zone rather than directly into receiving or storage.
Sales aisles must preserve regular retail circulation and sightline logic while allowing localized ruin and blockage.
Receiving must connect directly to stockroom and cold-storage functions through a plausible stocking route.
Cold-chain areas must be adjacent to service/refrigeration infrastructure and must not appear as arbitrary isolated rooms.
The large-span retail shell must retain credible structural support even where localized roof collapse is represented.

damage_doctrine.intent: Looted and weather-damaged food retail shell with partial roof and fixture failure while preserving retail and logistics identity.
